response.core_entity: Richter's transformation (transformation of chronic lymphocytic leukemia to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma) presenting as penile ulcer

modifier_claims.support_quote: His medical history included an elevated white blood cell count and inguinal lymphadenopathy discovered 9 years prior. Four years after initial presentation, he experienced fatigue, weight loss, and loss of appetite.

Biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+, within the background of a reactive T-cell infiltrate. PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement.
painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis of 1 month's duration
